description.value: Don Tacos is a Mexican fast-food spot in Richmond, BC offering dine-in alongside delivery and pickup ordering. The OSM record places it on level 1 of a building, suggesting an upstairs or mall-level unit rather than a street-front location. Cyclists passing through Richmond's busy urban grid will find it a convenient stop for a quick Mexican meal.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 70m; rack (4 spaces, covered) at 92m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating Mexican fast-food restaurant in Richmond with confirmed online ordering presence. Useful to touring cyclists as a meal stop.
